name: Volterra-Hankel operator V_{a,Phi}
statement: (V f)(t) = int_0^t Phi(t) Phi(s) sinh(a(t-s)) f(s) ds on L^2([0,inf)), Phi the de Bruijn-Newman kernel of xi. Causal (lower-triangular), trace class, quasinilpotent, built from Phi only, no reference to zeros.

name: Two-way collapse of the section 15-27 programme
statement: Claimed chain: ||V_{a,Phi}|| <= 1 for all a>0 <=> block [[I,V],[V*,I]] >= 0 <=> K_a >= 0 <=> E_a(z)=X(a-iz) Hermite-Biehler <=> Phi-built canonical system (CDB-Exist) <=> RH. Later downgraded to conditional; the norm statement is false for large a (obstruction map P20).

name: Conjecture 27.2 fails above a* (map row P20)
statement: Galerkin ||V_{a,Phi}|| = 0.954 at a=37.5, 1.989 at a=40, 53.2 at a=50, 2.8e11 at a=100; crossing a* ~ 37.66 coincides with the Hilbert-Schmidt threshold. The Wiener-Hopf bound ||V|| <= ||Phi||_inf^2/a was retracted: causal sinh-convolution is not Toeplitz.

name: Hilbert-Schmidt closed-form bound sqrt(I_0 J_a)
statement: ||V_{a,Phi}||_op <= ||V||_HS <= sqrt(I_0 J_a), monotone in a (d/da sinh^2(au) >= 0), rigorously < 1 on a in (0, 34.98]; at a <= 0.5 the bound is 2.94e-4. Interval-certified (Krawczyk) on a 30-cell (U,a) grid, max 1.900e-4.

name: Truncation transfer L^2([0,U]) -> L^2([0,inf))
statement: Tail bound T_a(U) <= I_0 (pi^3/8) e^{(4+2a)U} exp(-2 pi e^{4U}): at U=4 below 10^{-24,247,990}. The finite-window norm of V_{a,Phi} equals the half-line norm to that accuracy for a <= 0.5.

name: det(I - V) carries no zero information
statement: V_{a,Phi} is trace class with tr V = 0 and is quasinilpotent, so det(I - V) = 1 identically; ||V||_1 ~ 2.57e-4 at a=0.5. A Fredholm-determinant -> Hadamard-product route to the zeros is empty.

name: V_{a,Phi} is not a multiplicative convolution
statement: Kernel Phi(t)Phi(s) sinh(a(t-s)) 1_{s<t} is not a function of t/s (two separate Phi factors), so Mellin transform does not diagonalise V; no symbol calculus on (0,inf) applies.

name: Volterra norm is blind to zero location (heat-flow and Beurling controls)
statement: Under H_t deformation ||V_{a,Phi_t}|| tracks the exp(t u^2) L^2 scale only; after normalising ||Phi_t||_2 = 1 no residual zero-location signal. A generic Beurling system has no self-dual Phi so V cannot be assembled. The statistic stays below 1 on both sides of Lambda.

name: Rank-two shear commutator V - V^#
statement: V - V^# = p(x) q* - q(x) p*, p = Phi cosh(a.), q = Phi sinh(a.): rank 2, range Phi span{e^{at}, e^{-at}}. Hence spec(i Gshear) = {+mu, -mu, 0}, mu = sqrt(|p|^2 |q|^2 - <p,q>^2), and ||Gshear||_op = ||V||_HS exactly.

name: Hidden-square existence is equivalent to its conclusion
statement: A Hermitian kernel has a factorisation K_a = int Psi conj(Psi) dnu iff K_a >= 0 (Aronszajn / Kolmogorov). Conjectures 25.2/25.3 (hidden-square kernel) and 16.4 are therefore logically equivalent to K_a >= 0, not an independent lever.

name: Analytic ceiling for the cosh passive core
statement: For all f in L^2([0,U]): Q(f) = int sinh(a tau) f^2 / int cosh(a tau) f^2 <= tanh(aU) < 1, sup not attained; operator form (P - H) >= (1 - tanh(aU)) P. Scalar-core statement; extension to the rank-2 matrix core depends on which shear is meant.

name: Shear Gram sign pattern forced by Phi >= 0
statement: For Phi >= 0 on [0,U], sign Gshear(u,v) = sign(v - u) on all off-diagonal mass (measured 100 percent, zero mismatch, and structurally guaranteed). The near-diagonal bridge sign uses only positivity of Phi, not its arithmetic.

name: Linear-shear capture norm = peak slope of the Phi power spectrum
statement: As a -> 0 the shear numerator is skew-Toeplitz Ttilde(u,v) = a (v-u) R(|v-u|), R the Phi autocorrelation, and ||Ttilde|| = a sup_xi |d/dxi |Phihat(xi)|^2|. Maximiser xi* = 12.0667 (grid-converged), U-independent, unique; capture constant C_inf = 0.17514.

name: Super-exponential law of the Phi autocorrelation A(tau)
statement: A(tau) = int_0^inf Phi(s) Phi(s+tau) ds satisfies -ln A(tau) = pi e^{4 tau} + c_inf + (3/(2 pi)) e^{-2 tau} + O(e^{-4 tau}), c_inf = -ln((pi/2) Phi(0)) = 0.354292284; Watson remainder |rho(tau)| <= 3.46 e^{-4 tau} (numerically verified).

name: Bridge-mass moment expansion and degree-d miss factor
statement: With M_n = int tau^n A(tau) dtau: degree-d bridge mass B_d(a) = (a^d/d!) M_d + E, |E| <= (a^{d+2}/(d+2)!) M_{d+2} cosh(a T_A). Scaling B_d(a/k, kU) misses by exactly 1 - 1/k^{d+1}; degree-0 law B(a/k,kU) = k B(a,U).

name: Saddle ratio of A-weighted moments dips below 1
statement: Q_n = M_{n+2}/M_n follows tau*(n)^2 with n = 4 pi tau* e^{4 tau*}; correction eps_n changes sign near n = 149; exact-saddle ratio R_n crosses 1 at n* = 215.2, has a sub-unity well (min ~ -5.8e-4 near n ~ 500) and recovers from below up to n = 2200. Three independent quadratures agree.

name: Skew-Toeplitz shear sections: paired spectrum with (j^2 - 1) amplitude law
statement: Finite sections of the skew-Toeplitz shear operator have eigenvalues in exact pairs lambda_{2j-1} = lambda_{2j}; -log(lambda_{2j-1}/lambda_1) = C (j^2 - 1) + O(N^-3), C ~ N^-2. Both facts follow from one hypothesis: a Dirichlet-Laplacian ladder mu_k = C k^2 doubled by skew-symmetry. The hypothesis is selected by measured ratios, not derived.

name: Overflow onset of the cosh completion at s0 = arcsinh(1)
statement: Degree-0 bridge mass B = sinh(aU)/a - U; raw deficit D_0 = [cosh(aU) - sqrt2 + arcsinh(1)]/a - U; margin B/D depends on s = aU only. Excess fraction phi(s) has a double pole C/(s - s0)^2 at s0 = arcsinh(1), C = 0.16776, and decays exponentially; its integral diverges at onset.

name: Positivity range of the truncated kernel Phi_N
statement: Phi_N (N theta terms) stays positive left of the last per-term sign flip u_1* = (1/2) ln(3/(2 pi)) = -0.36963; leftmost zero u_0(N) ~ (1/2) ln(5/(2 pi N^2)) with Gaussian-curvature correction coefficient 5/(14 pi) and subleading -3/4.

name: No closure route is both PCC-free and not RH-equivalent
statement: Enumeration: twin-ladder routes A/B/C/D, Volterra, normalised R / mu^pass and the off-diagonal Hankel cover are each already RH-equivalent (Theorem 16.1 plus section-26 verdicts). The target set {pair-correlation-free AND not shown RH-equivalent} is empty.

name: Volterra/HS framework extends to Selberg-class L-functions
statement: Phi_L decays super-exponentially for every degree n; HS bound sqrt(I_0^L J_a^L) holds numerically for Delta, weight-16 form, a Maass form (R = 9.5337), Dirichlet chi_q (q = 3,5,7,11), five imaginary quadratic Dedekind zetas; Cauchy-Schwarz slack 1.7-2.6. Rankin-Selberg margin exceeds 2 at large weight gap.

name: Sym^m functoriality of the contraction needs uniform Rankin-Selberg residue bound
statement: Res_{s=1} L(s, sym^m f x sym^m f) = prod_{j=1}^m L(1, sym^{2j} f) (exact). Contraction survives under a_m ~ a_0/log Q_m iff log c_m = O(log Q_m). Margin h_m = 1 - log c_m/log Q_m is bounded under GRH but unconditionally behaves like 1 - 0.778 m/log m, negative from sym^4.

name: Krein-Langer negative-index identity (section 17.4)
statement: ind_-(K_{R_a}) = kappa(a) = #{lambda : X(lambda) = 0, Re lambda > a}, with multiplicity, for the shifted scattering ratio R_a. kappa(a) = 0 for all a > 0 iff R_a is Schur iff E_a Hermite-Biehler iff RH. Obstruction map Q6 gives the same inertia theorem in bridge language.

name: Two numerical detectors of ind_-(K_a)
statement: Rectangular argument-principle winding and Birman-Krein spectral shift return the same integer index; with several injected off-line conjugate pairs the winding equals the exact pole count. An injected off-line zero moves the Pick index of the reconstructed m-function from 0 to kappa.

name: Explicit de Branges / Jacobi chain for the twin-ladder m-function
statement: Under RH m(z) = sum_n 1/(t_n - z) is Nevanlinna N_0 and is realised numerically as a trace-normed canonical system dy/dx = z J H(x) y built from indivisible intervals. Off-line zeros are admissible only in a Pontryagin space Pi_kappa. A Phi-built (not zero-built) H is not known.

name: CDB-Exist: Phi-built canonical system
statement: For every a > 0 construct from Phi alone (not from the zeros of X) a Hamiltonian dm_a on R_+ whose Krein-Weyl Cayley transform is Theta_a = E_a^#/E_a, E_a = A_a - i B_a, A_a = int Phi cosh(au) cos(zu) du, B_a = int Phi sinh(au) sin(zu) du. Direct construction reduces to Hermite-Biehler positivity (RH-equivalent).

name: Conjecture 15.4: Re xi'/xi(sigma+it) > 0 for sigma > 1/2
statement: Pointwise domination of the prime-delay echo train (log p) p^{-m/2} e^{-iTm log p} by the gamma/kernel drift. Equivalent to RH (every paired Hadamard term u/(u^2 + (v -+ gamma)^2) is positive); numerical audit only confirms the triviality under verified height. Compare map rows G8, P8.

name: Restricted reciprocal Mobius-delay lift (App H) and its conditioning barrier
statement: Degree-2 self-reciprocal proxy p(z) = 1 + cz + z^2 for the bridge ratio Theta_a. Bounded-real passes at a = 0.025 (Gram cond ~ 342, c = -0.0183); at a <= 0.015 the central-band Gram is near-singular (cond ~ 8.2e4 at a = 0.010, |Theta^lift| ~ 1.0031 at omega = 0.1).

name: Conjecture 22.1 frozen-ladder obstruction (map row P30)
statement: For Phi_fr = sum_j e^{-alpha_j u^2} P_j(u^2) with coefficient dimension D, the Fourier transform has at most 2D - 2 real zeros, so matching sign changes of Xi up to Platt-Trudgian height needs D of the order of the zero count. Modulated variants: Nyquist floor U ~ (1/2) log(T0/2 pi) - 1/2.

name: Freezing as inertia-preserving reduction (section 23)
statement: Freezing a finite window of the ladder preserves inertia and gives finite-window certificates; it is not a proof step. The actual target is passive frozen-bridge closure (Conj 23.5) surviving U -> inf, W -> C_+, a -> 0.

name: Twin-ladder route D = prime side of the Connes/Weil trace formula
statement: The twin-ladder quadratic form is the prime side of the Weil explicit formula on C_Q in log-prime delay coordinates; Path C (Weil positivity) and route D coincide; Approach III (Pontryagin index) equals the inverse-Blaschke-ghost count. Scaling-site / arithmetic-site geometry leaves positivity RH-equivalent.

name: Paper conjectures subsumed by RH
statement: Conjectures 15.2 (zero bridge thickness), 17.3/18.4 (ghost absence), 22.4 are RH restated; 16.4, 16.6, 18.1, 18.2 reduce to canonical-system existence; KYP / delay-Gram appendices M-O add nothing independent. Only 22.1 and 27.2 were independent, and both are now closed (P30, P20).

name: Nyman-Beurling and the Volterra chain share no transfer mechanism (compare P14)
statement: Baez-Duarte / BBLS quantitative forms are RH-equivalent without Lambda content; no derivable map carries a Nyman-Beurling distance margin to a Volterra contraction margin or back.

name: Winding of arg H_tau is non-increasing in tau
statement: winding = (sign changes of H_tau on the line)/2 is monotone non-increasing along the de Bruijn-Newman flow; flat at 6.5 on tau in [0,0.2] for the tested window (zeros stay real). Monotonicity is classical (de Bruijn); later work identified the proxy as the exact flow at negative time.

name: Direction of the Lambda bridge inequality
statement: Lambda <= -t_c + E(N) is fed by a lower bound on t_c; with t_c >= 0 it reads Lambda <= E(N). The lever is the bridge error E(N) = E_trunc + E_flow + E_coll, not the collision time. E_coll (>= 84 percent of E) rests on the unproved shock-Lipschitz constant C_H.

name: C_H shock-Lipschitz modulus is not N-uniform by Gronwall
statement: C_H = C_shock C_Lip / 4: C_shock(N) = sqrt(2/(3 log gamma_N)) is explicit and bounded (< 1/3 for N >= 2458), but C_Lip from the flow-Jacobian Gronwall route diverges (collision integral diverges; C_Theta grows ~ N^0.92). Every finite-height Lambda < 0.2 claim through E_coll is conditional on it.

name: Recomposed bridge Lambda in [0.099, 0.137] is a height-mismatch artifact
statement: The bound combined a collision estimate at one height with truncation at another; at matched height every independent estimator is vacuous. Verified zero height (3e12) is the binding input (truncation elasticity -0.4 in T_PT); map rows F3, F6.

name: Backward de Bruijn flow: only logarithmic conditional stability
statement: Backward flow amplifies wavenumber k by exp(t k^2); log-convexity gives ||P_{<=K} u(t)|| <= e^{tK^2} ||P_{<=K} u(0)||, so the constant at zero-resolving cutoff is exp(T (log gamma_N)^2/(4 pi^2)), N-divergent. Forward DBM rigidity (Erdos-Schlein-Yau) does not transfer backward. Same wall as map F1.

name: Twin-ladder shift axis commutes past the heat-flow axis
statement: Ladder phase tomography (Hardy Z decomposition) is circular on the line; the shift d/da is transverse to d/dt of H_t, so ladder phase data carry no Lambda information unless a deformation with non-vanishing commutator [d/da, H_t] is constructed. None was found.

name: Backward Dyson flow is gradient descent of -log Disc
statement: For dx_k/ds = -2 sum_{j != k} 1/(x_k - x_j): d/ds log Disc = -sum_k xdot_k^2 = -8 sum_{i<j} (x_i - x_j)^{-2} < 0. Disc decreases strictly to 0 and t_c(N) is its smallest positive root; the heat-evolved polynomial gives t_c = H_min^2/8 for the dominant pair.

name: Minimal-gap sandwich for the collision time
statement: Gap ODE dr/ds = -4/r + 2 r B(s); u = r^2 gives du/ds = -8 + 4 B u. If |B| <= beta then (1/(4 beta)) log(1 + beta g^2/2) <= t_c <= -(1/(4 beta)) log(1 - beta g^2/2). Isolated pair: g0^2/8 <= t_c <= (g0^2/8)(1 + x), x = E0 g0^2/4 <= 1/2.

name: Background field of an adjacent pair: B_p G^2 < 2
statement: No particle lies between an adjacent pair, so every summand of B_p is positive; with global minimal gap G the k-th flank particle is at distance >= kG and B_p G^2 <= 2(1 - 1/(K+1)) < 2. The sup over flow time reduces to one scalar c_0 = h_min(0)/g_min(0) (punctured-gap ratio), which is not known uniformly.

name: Gap-domination bootstrap: two-sided t_c enclosure on N in [1e4, 1e6]
statement: On each H_raw plateau with horizon T = H^2/(8 thetaBar), thetaBar = 0.99: d(g^2)/dt <= -8 theta, so H^2/8 <= t_c <= H^2/(8 theta) and 0 <= F_mb <= (H^2/8)(1/theta - 1). Deterministic, RH-free, certified on all 10 plateaus given the zero table.

name: Collision-time transfer modulus in the vector-field-error channel
statement: For flows dx/dt = F_Dyson + e with |e_{l+1} - e_l| <= eps' g_l from the same zero data: |Delta t_c| <= W(eps') = tHi - tLo, dW/deps' ~ 3 H^4/64, N-uniform, no Gronwall or W_1 distance. Bridge re-architecture gives E_field <= 5.17e-7; residual is certifying eps' for the true flow.

name: Calogero-Moser Hessian excludes an edge-scale rigidity escape
statement: Route A monotonicity closes with bulk rigidity N^{-1} and stays open at edge rigidity N^{-2/3}. An edge escape needs coupling ratio rho <= N^{-1/3}; the many-body CM Hessian gives rho_CM(N) >= 1, growing like N^{0.40}. The needed local law is not delivered by any unconditional input.

name: Finite-N resolvent flux identity (complex Burgers with viscosity)
statement: Along the attractive Calogero-Moser / backward Dyson flow the Stieltjes transform m(z,s) satisfies m_s = 2 m m_z + m_zz exactly at finite N; the identity survives numerically to 0.99 of the pre-collision budget. Inviscid limit is complex Burgers; the collision is a fold with Holder-1/2 exponent.

name: Mean-field limit for the attractive singular flow
statement: No propagation-of-chaos or empirical-measure convergence theorem (Sznitman, Rogers-Shi, Cepa-Lepingle, Serfaty modulated energy, Jabin-Wang) covers the attractive sign of dx_k/ds = -2 sum 1/(x_k - x_j). Needed: uniform-in-N curvature lower bound and perturbation control on a strip above the fold (H3, H4); the admissible strip is empty for N >= 1e3.

name: Density floor from the uniform lattice
statement: For an equally spaced lattice of spacing d: sup_x Im M(x + iy) = (pi/d) coth(pi y/d) (Mittag-Leffler cotangent identity). With d = 2 pi/log(gamma/2 pi) this gives the measured V0/log(gamma/2 pi) = 0.48458, constant to machine precision over the height ladder.

name: Per-site flow depth s_k = c g_k^2
statement: Collision time tau_c ~ g_k^2/8 and the Gronwall floor-pinning depth both scale as g_k^2, so running each pair backward only to depth c g_k^2 keeps the floor exp(-2s/y^2) non-vacuous. A single global depth makes the Gronwall floor vacuous (intrinsic). Scaling estimate plus one RK4 run.

name: Two-point gap structure function S_2(r)
statement: S_2(r) = mean_k (g_{k+r} - g_k)^2 on the first 1e6 zero gaps is a smooth function of separation r; proposed as a two-point x-difference modulus object for the shock front. Diagnostic only.

name: Minimum-gap site is not uniformly confined to the bulk
statement: Uniform-in-N bulk confinement of the minimal-gap index k*_N is refuted by a record-time lemma plus a 1e6-zero witness; only a density-form restatement survives. On N in (1e4, 1e6] the record gap H_raw drops only 9 times.

name: Measured backward-Dyson collision-time ladder to N = 1e6
statement: Interval-RK4 collision times t_c(N) for N up to 1e6 (25k-100k rungs closed with one-ULP interval arithmetic), cross-checked by DOP853 at N = 1e4, 1e5 and by the exact pair collapse. Units conversion between the CM-flow time and de Bruijn-Newman time is pinned.

name: Phased forcing of the Dyson flow loses effect with N
statement: A resonant forcing (k0* ~ 2 pi/min_gap, tuned phase velocity) reduces the collision statistic by a factor 185-111 at N = 500, but the reduction factor degrades with N at fixed (k0, omega).

name: All ESY-closure routes meet pair correlation at support > 1
statement: Direct Selberg, Sobolev-via-Hughes-Rudnick and higher-cumulant routes each need Montgomery pair correlation beyond support 1 (and rho_3 at a later step). Selberg trace, Goldston-Gonek, Heath-Brown fourth moment, Goldston-Yildirim, Tao entropy and Maynard sieve give the same (log T)^{1/2} Cauchy-Schwarz gap in support (1, 5/4). Mean-value inputs: map MV-CAP.

name: Band-limited variance gap closes as exp(-4 pi W)
statement: With unconditional Rudnick-Sarnak support the ESY variance residual is N-independent (2.153e-3 at band 2/n). Widening the test bandwidth W reduces it as exp(-4 pi W): factor 4351 per extra band of width 2/3; zero residual only at W = infinity.

name: ESY rigidity port needs two independent inputs
statement: Obstacles O1, O3 (derandomisation, equidistribution) lie on an arithmetic axis; O2 (backward flow) on a PDE well-posedness axis. Both inputs are unavailable and their residuals are disjoint, so no single input closes the port. Determinantal CLT is not a weaker citable substitute.

name: L^2 linear statistics do not give sup-norm control
statement: Hughes-Rudnick variance to the sup-norm observable psi_N by Sobolev embedding loses sqrt(N). Koksma-Hlawka second-moment route improves N^{-3/2} to N^{-7/4} unconditionally but not N^{-2}; Erdos-Turan variants inherit the same circularity. Instance of mean-value versus every-window.

name: Three-point correlation of 1e6 zeros matches the sine-kernel determinant
statement: Empirical R_3(x,y) on 1e6 Odlyzko zeros agrees with the GUE determinantal prediction (Pearson below 0.995 after bin integration); insensitive to the bridge perturbation parameter. Unrestricted-support 3-point input is not available: regularisation penalty is N-independent.

name: Windowed edge statistic of zeros versus Tracy-Widom
statement: Sliding-window largest-eigenvalue statistic built from zeta zeros shows a systematic deviation above 0.10 from Tracy-Widom beta = 2; follow-ups (Airy-kernel quadrature, Painleve-II F_2) show the comparison is discretisation-limited, not resolved.

name: Costin-Lebowitz / Soshnikov variance bound for zero linear statistics
statement: A rigorous partial upper bound on the variance of microscopic-scale linear statistics of zeros ported from the CUE fluctuation argument; cross-validated against Wieand CUE bulk statistics and the Conrey-Snaith arithmetic correction (corrected slope -0.997).

name: Random multiplicative models do not derandomise to zeta
statement: Harper-type random multiplicative function results transfer to deterministic zeta through none of four tested mechanisms (D1-D4); the random-zeta link is a heuristic model (Wintner, Keating-Snaith), not a proof input.

name: ZPO operator spectrum versus sine kernel
statement: The project's Hilbert-Polya style zero-point-oscillator construction has real-space pair correlation close to the GUE sine kernel at finite N. The construction takes zeros as input; no independent operator is produced.

name: Spectral / trace-formula family gives no single-zeta bypass
statement: SL(2,Z) Selberg trace, Hecke triangle groups, Connes-Bost adelic trace, Berry-Keating xp (Sierra-Townsend matches smooth density only), Bender-Brody-Mueller: none realises the zeros as a constructed spectrum. Phillips-Sarnak: cuspidal density would need to exceed Weyl by (log T)^{1/2}.

name: Family averages do not localise to one L-function
statement: Iwaniec-Sarnak: positive proportion of L(1/2, f x chi_d) >= (log D)^{-A} for |d| <= D. The mechanism averages over the family and gives no statement for a single zeta at all heights.

name: Levinson-Conrey mollification is locked to the critical line (compare P26)
statement: A mollified positivity functional on sigma = 1/2 + eps cannot count zeros in a strip: the method uses the functional-equation symmetry on the line; strip confinement routes back to zero-density estimates.

name: Phase of zeta right of the line: counting does not locate
statement: S(sigma,T) for sigma > 1/2 is defined without circularity only when the strip is zero-free; Backlund rectangles count zeros and are decoupled from the heat flow; Voronin universality implies the image closure is all of C, so no topological lever. The quantity segmentArgDelta in the survey is not a winding number.

name: Explicit zero-density constants: the (log T)^A factor
statement: Ingham at sigma = 3/4 gives truncation term 3.06e-5 at T = 3e12 (interval-certified). Bui-Soundararajan and Guth-Maynard exponents substitute formally (factor 2.04e6 and 2.13) but unspecified (log T)^A / o(1) factors block rigour: at A = 6 the net effect is a 275-fold loss. Needs a log-free large-values lemma (map Z12, Z17).

name: Lower bounds on |zeta|^2 loosen the Weil prime side
statement: In the section 18.3 Weil/Pontryagin explicit-formula attack, a lower bound on |zeta|^2 gives a lower bound in absolute value on the prime side, which is the wrong direction for tightening.

name: Robin / Nicolas margins are Mertens-governed
statement: Robin margin e^gamma - sigma(N)/(N log log N) along colossally abundant numbers and the Nicolas primorial margin grow at rates fixed by Mertens-type arithmetic; neither converts to a de Bruijn-Newman or zero-location quantity. Li coefficients lambda_n computed to n = 300 positive (map P16).

name: Design for extending verified zero height toward 1e14
statement: Engineering study (no zeros computed) of GPU-accelerated verification beyond Platt-Trudgian 3e12; feasible with amortised Odlyzko-Schonhage, two engineering risks named. No peer-reviewed successor to 3e12 found at audit time. Finite certificates restate verified height.

name: Star discrepancy of zeros from S(T)
statement: The 1-D Koksma-Hlawka step uses the Kolmogorov-Smirnov discrepancy, which Riemann-von Mangoldt gives as sup|S(T)|/N-type with Trudgian's explicit S(T) coefficient (C_Selberg 2.622 vs placeholder 3.0). A genuine Erdos-Turan bridge fed only by S(T) gives coefficient ~9.98, 26 times the headroom.

name: Zero ghost count above 3e12 is an assumption
statement: The earlier asymptotic Lambda <= 7.98e-4 candidate implicitly assumed ind_-(K_{R_a}) = 0 above the verified height; the composition breaks there. The later 3.06e-5 chain is conditional on the Polymath15 shock-Lipschitz step (G6a).

name: Envelope form of the collision-time monotonicity
statement: Pointwise per-N monotonicity (M) of the collision ladder fails at small N (12 certified violations) but the envelope restatement (M-env) is a theorem and suffices for the intercept conclusion; trajectory domination resolved positive.

name: Particle versus mean-field proxy error does not decay polynomially
statement: Paper Theorem 3 is a mean-field-proxy statement; E_pp(N) = |t_c^part - t_c^MF| ~ pi/log. Only an identity that subtracts t_c^MF (rather than bounding it) avoids stalling. NoSwap is refuted for zeta zeros.

name: Quadratic tangency law |tau_c| = g^2/8
statement: For the full N-particle gap ODE the collision coefficient is 8 with remainder of determined sign; with the Theta-trap (Theta <= 1/4) the coefficient 8(1 - Theta) lies in [6,8], giving g^2/8 <= t_c <= g^2/6. dTheta/dW_1 ~ 1/g0 off-basin (product pinned at 16/27).

name: Boundary-shock crossing-time field is monotone
statement: The crossing-time field tau*(y) = y/(2 Im m_0) is strictly increasing in y by Poisson-kernel monotonicity, so interior quadratic tangency is vacuous for the degenerate boundary shock; replaces one of two weak links in the G6a port.

name: Conditional share of the bridge budget turns over near N ~ 1e6
statement: sigma(N) = E_coll/E(N) is U-shaped (min 0.841), peaks ~0.949 near N_max ~ 9.2e5, then decays since E_coll ~ sqrt(log T0/N) while E_trunc is constant; sigma = 1/2 at N ~ 3.27e9. N_max ~ (1/E_trunc)^{1.38} and exists only for a constant floor.

name: Twin-ladder / Volterra machinery does not apply to partition parity
statement: Applicability assessment against the Parkin-Shanks conjecture on p(n) mod 2: fails; no kernel with the needed self-duality exists.
